tytul: Chocolate plum butter: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for plum butter with chocolate.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to NCHFP, chocolate sauces are low-acid recipes and a risk for botulism, so recipes that can them in a boiling-water canner are especially risky; there are also no tested recipes for canning chocolate sauces in a pressure canner.

akapity: According to Oregon State University Extension, fruit butters can be made from most high-acid fruits, among them plums.
Chocolate is a further addition outside any tested recipe.
JarAtlas rule (cautious): the NCHFP warning is about chocolate sauces, not fruit butters, but JarAtlas treats chocolate or cocoa as a low-acid ingredient that is not part of any tested fruit butter.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for plum butter with chocolate from a checked source.
